description.value: You possess a deep knowledge of your people's history and customs, and you can leverage that knowledge to influence your fellow verthanis and other citizens of Verces. You might be a scholar or diplomat, or you might be a member of the Pure Ones. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Society checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] about Verces and verthanis. In addition, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Charisma-based skill checks against verthanis and other citizens of Verces.
